title: Clues About Mother
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng's figure solidified in the Void, his ancient yet profound eyes reflecting the yellowed Jade Pendant in Chen Ji's hand—'Young Master, your father Chen Tianming... will return in three months.'

text.content: Deep within the dense forest of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Chen Ji read the imperial court's secret letter three times. The characters were already etched into his memory, and the subtle hidden mark had been rubbed almost burning hot by his fingertips. Just then, a piercing sound came from outside the forest. Chen Ji looked up to see a black shadow swooping down like a hawk. The visitor's aura was restrained like an abyss, yet carried an inexplicable sense of familiarity—a feeling that made Chen Ji's heart leap. Imperial court envoy? Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, maintaining his seemingly timid appearance, but his mind was already racing through countless thoughts. In his previous life, he had no connections with the imperial court, yet in this life, what chess piece had his mother positioned in the imperial court, to prompt the court to send someone to find him?

dialogue.content: (The envoy knelt on one knee, retrieving a yellowed Letter from his bosom) Young Master, subordinate Qin Wu, following the mistress for over thirty years. Today, by the late mistress's dying order, I personally deliver this letter into the young master's hands. The mistress... she never truly left you.

text.content: The moment the words 'Young Master' reached his ears, Chen Ji's aura momentarily stagnated. He stared at the Letter, its seal marked by an extremely faint rune—that was his mother's unique soul imprint, which Chen Ji had repeatedly traced in his memories during countless late nights of longing. Twenty years! He forcibly suppressed the turbulent waves in his heart, reached out to take the Letter. The moment his fingertips touched the paper, a warm current flowed into his palm, as if his mother were caressing his head across time and space.

dialogue.content: Before the mistress was sealed, she left this letter and this keepsake, instructing the subordinate to personally present them to the young master on the day of your rise. All these years, the subordinate has waited in the shadows of the imperial court, and finally this day has arrived. Young Master, the mistress... she is still alive, merely sealed within the depths of the imperial court's Forbidden Grounds, unable to解脱 (find release) between life and death.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly opened the envelope. The familiar handwriting came into view, each stroke carrying his mother's unique gentle elegance. Chen Ji gazed at the words in the letter—the shocking truths about the sealing, the arrangement, his origins—one sentence after another stirred tremendous waves in his heart. He lowered his eyes, hiding the momentary moistness in his gaze, but his hands trembled slightly—this was the first time he had lost composure since his rebirth.

dialogue.content: (Letter content) Ji'er, when you read this letter, mother has been sleeping within the seal for many years. The events of that year were not as simple as you know. Mother did not die in childbirth, but voluntarily made herself the container of the seal, to protect you and Nian'er. Mother waited within the seal for too long, only for you to become strong enough. When the Tianji Record chose me, I did not flee. Instead, I split the seal's key into two halves—one within my body, one within yours. Now the seal's time limit approaches, and only one condition remains: the Heavenly Fate must reach a critical point to safely break the seal.

text.content: The letter slipped from Chen Ji's fingers, drifting gently to the ground. He stared blankly at that yellowed paper, but before his eyes emerged countless late nights in his previous life with an eternally unresolvable regret—mother died in childbirth, father's life and death unknown, younger sister's whereabouts mysterious. Back then, he had countless times called for mother in his dreams, yet never received a response. Now the truth is revealed—mother had been waiting for him all along within the seal!

dialogue.content: (The first page of the Tianji Record suddenly glowed with faint light, Mo Xiansheng's voice echoing in Chen Ji's mind) Young Master, your mother's words are true. She was a key figure on the list from ten thousand years ago, chosen by the Tianji Record alongside Chen Xuan. Those who sealed her were not outsiders, but herself—transforming her body into a lock to protect you.

text.content: Chen Ji bent to pick up the letter, his knuckles white from force. He folded the letter carefully and tucked it close to his body, then extended his hand to help Qin Wu rise. His voice was low yet carried a sense of iron-blooded determination. Qin Wu, you've worked hard. What else did mother leave behind? Qin Wu hastily retrieved an ancient wooden box from his bosom, presenting it with both hands. The moment the lid opened, a warm and gentle aura rushed forth—inside quietly lay a white Jade Pendant and a strand of withered black hair. Those were mother's hairs, and Chen Ji remembered how mother always loved to coil her black hair into a bun, smiling as she watched him play.

dialogue.content: This Jade Pendant contains a strand of the mistress's divine consciousness, also the other key to breaking the seal. However, Young Master, the conditions the mistress mentioned for breaking the seal are extremely harsh—the Heavenly Fate must reach a certain critical point, and the 'Key of Heavenly Fate' must be found to succeed. Do you know who the 'Key of Heavenly Fate' is?

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, a flash of brilliant light in his eyes. The Key of Heavenly Fate—those four characters he had never dared to contemplate deeply. Seeing Chen Ji's altered expression, Qin Wu hastily explained in a low voice: The mistress once said that to break the seal, two things are needed—first, the Tianji Record Fragment in the young master's possession, and second... Second Miss Chen Nian. Nian'er is the Key of Heavenly Fate, the key to opening all seals!

Chen Ji closed his eyes for a moment. When he opened them again, they were already calm. He tucked the Jade Pendant close to his body, his gaze profound like an abyss. Mother had laid out a chess game for twenty years, planting hidden pieces in the imperial court, arranging contingencies in the sect, even sealing her own divine consciousness within the Jade Pendant, all just to wait for this day. And he, the so-called waste material, was from the very beginning the most crucial piece in mother's chess game.

choice.prompt: Mother's letter mentioned the conditions for breaking the seal, but every single path was filled with thorns. Faced with this sudden truth, Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: Mother has waited too long, I cannot let her suffer more. Even if the Heavenly Fate is insufficient, even if I must face the imperial court's Forbidden Grounds, I must act quickly.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate -50, Facing Danger of Imperial Court Forbidden Grounds
choices.visible_reward: May rescue mother ahead of schedule, obtain the complete layout left by mother
choices.risk_hint: Forcing my way into the imperial court's Forbidden Grounds with current strength will be extremely perilous

text.content: Chen Ji fiercely gripped the Jade Pendant, his knuckles white from force. Twenty years! He silently recited in his heart, killing intent gradually intensifying in his eyes. Mother had already suffered within the seal for twenty years, and he did not want to wait even one more second. Qin Wu, do you have the defensive layout of the imperial court's Forbidden Grounds? Qin Wu slightly startled, then retrieved a scroll of Sheepskin Paper from his bosom. Chen Ji took it and glanced at it, his expression unchanged on the surface, but in his heart he had already quickly deduced dozens of possibilities. Mother, wait for me.

choices.text: Wait for the Time to Mature
choices.description: Mother laid out a game for twenty years, I need more time to arrange my pieces. First complete the Tianji Record, then find sister Chen Nian—at that time, it will be foolproof.
choices.visible_cost: Need to wait a longer time
choices.visible_reward: More thorough preparation, greater chance of success
choices.risk_hint: The seal may have a time limit, and delay might cause us to miss this golden opportunity

text.content: Chen Ji pressed the Jade Pendant against his chest and closed his eyes. After a moment, he slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air, and his eyes had regained their usual calmness and depth. Mother has been laying out this game for twenty years. If I act rashly, wouldn't that disappoint all her painstaking efforts? Qin Wu, return to the imperial court first and continue to lie low. Contact me again once I've made thorough preparations. Qin Wu saluted with a fist, then vanished into the night.

choices.text: Take action only after perfecting the layout
choices.description: Mother's hidden piece is the activation condition. I need to first increase the completeness of the Tianji Record, then raise the Heavenly Fate value to the critical point, and then strike with certainty.
choices.visible_cost: Requires meticulous planning, may take several months
choices.visible_reward: Activating the complete hidden piece left by Mother will greatly increase the probability of success
choices.risk_hint: Unexpected changes may occur during the planning period

text.content: A subtle smile curved the corners of Chen Ji's lips, revealing a meaningful expression. Since Mother had laid out a hidden piece in the imperial court sufficient to overturn the three sects, the activation condition must be related to the completeness of the Tianji Record. If I can complete the Tianji Record to seventy percent in the shortest possible time, the hidden piece will automatically activate, and at that time, all of Mother's remaining backup plans will be at my disposal. Qin Wu, go back and tell Madame that her son will not disappoint her.

After Qin Wu departed, Chen Ji stood alone in the dense forest. The night wind brushed past, lifting the loose hair at his temples, revealing a face utterly different from his previous life. He took out the white Jade Pendant from his chest, gazing at its warm surface as if he could see his mother's gentle smile. Mother, you have waited twenty years, and your son will not make you wait another moment. Chen Ji carefully stored the Jade Pendant close to his body and turned toward the Tianqing Sect. His steps were composed, yet his back carried an unprecedented determination. In his previous life, he was a wandering spirit; in this life, he had the chess game left by his mother, a sister waiting to be rescued, and the capital to break his chains and overturn his fate. The completeness of the Tianji Record, his mother's rebirth, his sister's return—he wanted all of it.

dialogue.content: (An elderly voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind) Young master, since the clues about Mother are now clear, this old one should tell you another matter. Chen Tianming... your father, was not truly sealed back then, but voluntarily sacrificed himself to the Tianji Record. However, a wisp of his soul has been sleeping deep within the Tianji Record. What this old one wants to tell you tonight is that in three months, Chen Tianming will completely awaken, and at that time, the entire cultivation world's structure will change because of him.
